Overview

Mazatenango is a city in SU with a population of 80,000. A southwestern city known for its Carnival celebrations and agricultural production in the coastal lowlands. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
